zh.description: [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] 遗物、[ICON_GREATWORK_ARTIFACT] 文物和 [ICON_GREATWORK_SCULPTURE] 雕塑提供+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力、+4 [ICON_GOLD] 金币和+2 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]每次完成市政广场的建筑时，您都会获得一个 [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] 遗物。[NEWLINE]宫殿可容纳5个巨作槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]大作家、大艺术家和大音乐家点数+50%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]生产考古学家时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3雨林、T5树林。

Civilizations that are at war with Russia receive +100% unit damage from Blizzards in Russian territory.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Tundra.

International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes between multiple continents receive double these numbers. Cities at least 8 tiles away from [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital receive +25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards [ICON_DISTRICT] districts.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast, T3 Geothermal Fissure. Special "Continent Split".

Receive bonus [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] influence points from your maximum alliance level (2/4/6).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When you capture a [ICON_BARBARIAN] Barbarian Outpost, receive a Tribal Village reward in addition to the usual [ICON_GOLD] Gold reward. zh.name: 艾思科里亚
zh.description: 对抗信仰其他 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教的文明时，+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]传教士的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值花费降低25%。审判官额外拥有1次清除异教次数，且能完全消除其他 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教的影响。

en.name: El Escorial
en.description: Inquisitors can Remove Heresy one extra time. Inquisitors eliminate 100% of the presence of other Religions. Combat and Religious units have a bonus of +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength against players following other Religions. Missionaries are 25% cheaper to purchase.

zh.name: 送给国王的礼物

zh.name: 大使馆

zh.name: 英国强权下的和平

en.name: Pax Britannica

Naval melee units may escort civilian units at their higher movement speed. Gain the Redcoat unique unit when the Military Science technology is researched.[NEWLINE]Lighthouse grants +1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] Great Admiral point per turn.

zh.name: 正义的信仰

en.name: Righteousness of the Faith

It adds 5% to the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith to the city's output. Increasing an additional 5% with Reformed Church and an additional 5% when completing your religion.

zh.name: 宗教转换

Receives an Apostle (of that city's majority Religion) each time he finishes a Mbanza or Theater Square district.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Once you enter the classical era, all land combat units and [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great Generals ignore the Rainforest and Woods [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement penalty.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General points on barracks or stables. Rainforest and Woods tiles adjacent to an Encampment receive +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. These tiles also receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food once the city has constructed a Mbanza.

zh.name: 罗斯福推论
zh.description: 每通过科技或市政进入一个新时代（包含远古时代），单位+1 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力（上限至工业时代+5）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]向与你有 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的城邦派遣使者时，该使者视为两名 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。

en.name: Roosevelt Corollary
en.description: Units receive +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength per player era reached by technologies or civics (starting in Ancient Era up to Industrial Era, capped at +5). Envoys sent to City-states you have a [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route to count as two [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys. Gain the Rough Rider unique unit with Ballistics technology.

zh.name: 非暴力不合作
zh.description: 创立 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教时可获得1个额外信条。[NEWLINE]每遇到一个创立了 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教且不处于战争状态的文明（包括印度自己），+5 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]拥有圣地的城市训练的建造者和开拓者+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]与甘地交战的文明产生+50%厌战情绪。

en.name: Satyagraha
en.description: Grants an extra belief when founding a [ICON_RELIGION] Religion. +5 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each civilization (including India) they have met that has founded a Religion and is not currently at war.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settlers and Builders produced in cities with a Holy Site receive +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. Opposing civilizations receive +50% war weariness for fighting against Gandhi.

zh.name: 北方惊雷
zh.description: 训练海军近战单位时+25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，且海军近战单位可以进行海岸扫荡。[NEWLINE]对矿山进行掠夺和海岸扫荡除 [ICON_GOLD] 金币外还能获得 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。对采石场、牧场、种植园和营地进行掠夺和海岸扫荡除 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值外还能获得 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]海军近战单位+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]解锁“造船术”科技后，除四段帆船外的所有单位可进入海洋单元格。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]维京长船和狂暴武士在海洋单元格没有 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力惩罚。

en.name: Thunderbolt of the North
en.description: +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength and +25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Naval Melee Units. Naval Melee units can perform coastal raids. Receive additional yields from pillaging or performing coastal raids: [ICON_SCIENCE] Science from Mines, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Quarries, Pastures, Plantations, and Camps.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Units excepts quadriremes gain the ability to enter Ocean tiles after researching the Shipbuilding technology. The Longship and Berserker only use 1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement to enter Ocean tiles.

zh.name: 秦始皇
zh.description: 建造者获得额外1次 [ICON_Charges] 劳动力。您可以消耗1次建造者 [ICON_Charges] 劳动力来加速远古和古典奇观15%的原始建造进程。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每建成一座世界奇观，城市+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]建成奇观时，将随机获得一项该奇观所处时代的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“砌砖”科技解锁运河。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]长城如果与另外两个长城单元格相邻，额外提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币和+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。

en.name: The First Emperor
en.description: Builder receive an additional [ICON_CHARGES] charge. When building Ancient and Classical Wonders you may spend Builder [ICON_CHARGES] charge to complete 15% of the Wonder [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food per wonder built in each city. Canals are unlocked with the Masonry technology.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When completing a wonder receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration from the era of the wonder if available.

zh.name: 凯瑟琳的亲卫队
zh.description: 您的 [ICON_VISLIMITED] 外交能见度比已遇到的其他文明高1级。

en.name: Catherine's Flying Squadron
en.description: Has 1 level of [ICON_VisLimited] Diplomatic Visibility greater than normal with every civilization that she's met.

zh.name: 图拉真圆柱
zh.description: 解锁“帝国初期”市政后，所有现有及未来建立的城市将获得 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力花费最低的市中心建筑。

en.name: Trajan's Column
en.description: All founded cities receive a free building in the City Center after unlocking Early Empire.

zh.name: 居鲁士终结者
zh.description: 所有单位攻击受伤单位时，+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力（进入中世纪后提升至+5）。[NEWLINE]击杀敌方单位时恢复30点生命值。

en.name: Killer of Cyrus
en.description: All units receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking wounded units, increasing to +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength after you enter the Medieval Era. When they eliminate a unit, they heal up to 30 hit points.

zh.name: 宽宏大量
zh.description: 招募或赞助一位 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人后，将返还所消耗 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人点数的20%。

zh.name: 被荣耀包围
zh.description: 您每宗主一个城邦，您的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩便提升+5%。[NEWLINE]完成古罗马剧场后提供1名 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]卫城每相邻一个世界奇观提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，每相邻一个 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+0.5 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.name: Surrounded by Glory
en.description: +5% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +5% [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per City-state you are Suzerain of.[NEWLINE]Awards 1 [ICON_ENVOY] envoy when an Amphitheater is completed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acropolis receives standard production adjacency from wonders and minor production adjacency from districts.

zh.name: 科技城邦
zh.description: 派遣1位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： [ICON_Capital] 首都和每座图书馆+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值。[NEWLINE]派遣3位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 每座图书馆+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。[NEWLINE]派遣6位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 每座大学+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。

en.name: Scientific City-State
en.description: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Science] Science in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Library building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Science] Science in every Library building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Science] Science in every University building.

zh.name: 宗教城邦

en.name: Religious City-State
en.description: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Shrine building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith in every Shrine building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith in every Temple building.

zh.name: 贸易城邦
zh.description: 派遣1位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： [ICON_Capital] 首都和每座市场/灯塔+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。[NEWLINE]派遣3位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 每座市场与灯塔建筑+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。[NEWLINE]派遣6位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 每间银行与造船厂建筑+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

en.name: Trade City-State
en.description: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Market or Lighthouse building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold in every Market and Lighthouse building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold in every Bank and Shipyard building.

zh.name: 文化城邦

en.name: Cultural City-State
en.description: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Amphitheater building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture in every Amphitheater building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture in every Art Museum and Archeological Museum building.

zh.name: 军事城邦

en.name: Militaristic City-State
en.description: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Production] Production in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every city with a Barracks or Stable when producing units.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with a Barracks or Stable building when producing units.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with an Armory building when producing units.

zh.name: 工业城邦
zh.description: 派遣1位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 建造奇观、建筑和区域时，[ICON_Capital] 首都和拥有工作坊的城市+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE]派遣3位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 建造奇观、建筑和区域时，拥有工作坊的城市+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE]派遣6位 [ICON_Envoy] 使者： 建造奇观、建筑和区域时，拥有工厂的城市+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

en.name: Industrial City-State
en.description: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Production] Production in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every city with a Workshop building when producing wonders, buildings, and districts.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with a Workshop building when producing wonders, buildings, and districts.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with a Factory building when producing wonders, buildings, and districts.

en.description: [ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas provide an additional +5% of the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science cost for researching technologies.

zh.name: 喀布尔宗主国加成

zh.name: 库马西宗主国加成

zh.name: 拉文塔宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“巨神头像”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+2 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值和+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。每相邻2个雨林提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值（“人文主义”市政后提升至每相邻1个）。每相邻2个树林提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值（“人文主义”市政后提升至每相邻1个）。“飞行”科技后基于信仰产出提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。不能建在雪地或雪地丘陵上。

en.name: La Venta Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Builders can now make Colossal Head improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest or Woods, increasing to +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each adjacent Rainforest or Woods after researching Humanism. [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from [ICON_FAITH] Faith after researching Flight. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.

zh.name: 摩亨朱-达罗宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的所有城市获得等同于位于淡水水源旁的最高 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房加成。

en.name: Nan Madol Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your [ICON_DISTRICT] specialty districts on or next to Coast or Lake tiles provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Additional +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture once the Exploration civic is reached.

zh.name: 首尔宗主国加成
zh.description: 当您进入一个新时代时，从该时代随机获得1个 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡时刻。

en.name: Seoul Suzerain Bonus
en.description: When you enter a new era, earn 1 random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka from that era.

zh.name: 多伦多宗主国加成
zh.description: 来自您工业区和娱乐区的区域效应范围增加3个单元格。

en.name: Toronto Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Regional effects from your Industrial Zone and Entertainment Complex districts reach 3 tiles farther.

zh.name: 瓦莱塔宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许使用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值购买市中心和军营的建筑。购买城墙的花费降低。

zh.name: 埃里温宗主国加成

en.name: Zanzibar Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Receive the [ICON_RESOURCE_CINNAMON] Cinnamon Luxury resource and with Banking the [ICON_RESOURCE_CLOVES] Cloves Luxury resource. These cannot be earned any other way in the game, and provide +6 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities each.

zh.name: 五个太阳的传说

en.name: Legend of the Five Suns
en.description: Spend a Builder [ICON_CHARGES] charge to complete 30% of the original [ICON_DISTRICT] district cost.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards land melee units.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

印度尼西亚特色改良设施：甘榜屋
伟大千岛之国

en.name: Great Nusantara
en.description: Coast and Lake tiles provide a minor adjacency bonus for Campus, Theater Square, Holy Site, and Industrial Zone districts. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from entertainment to each Entertainment Complex adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 群岛国家

en.description: Likes civilizations who avoid settling or conquering cities on small landmasses.  Hates anyone with numerous cities on such islands.

zh.name: 大人工湖
zh.description: 拥有水渠的城市+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE]与水渠相邻的农场+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]与圣地相邻的农场+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建成圣地后触发文化炸弹。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3河流。

zh.name: 奥克兰宗主国加成
zh.description: 城市领土内已改良的海岸（浅水）单元格提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力（进入工业时代后提升至+2）。

en.name: Auckland Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Improved shallow water tiles you own provide +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, increasing to +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production when you reach the Industrial Era.

zh.name: 塔那那利佛宗主国加成
zh.description: 每招募一位 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人，+2% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（上限为30%）。

zh.name: 阿尔马宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“修道院”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+3 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值和+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。“归正会”市政后，每相邻1个 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。“殖民主义”市政后+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。在该单元格上且本回合未攻击的友方单位恢复15点生命值。“飞行”科技后基于信仰产出提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。两座修道院不能相邻。

en.name: Armagh Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Builders can now make Monastery improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. +15 HP healing for friendly religious unit on this tile that has not attacked this turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for every 2 adjacent districts, increasing to +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each adjacent district at Reformed Church. Additional +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing with the Colonialism civic. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism equal to [ICON_FAITH] Faith after researching Flight.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cannot be built next to another Monastery.

zh.name: 格拉纳达宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“阿卡萨城堡”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力和+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。每相邻1个军营额外提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。提供等同于该单元格魅力50%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。驻守单位获得+4防御 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力、+1视野及驻扎加成。“飞行”科技后基于文化产出提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。两座阿卡萨城堡不能相邻。

en.name: Granada Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Builders can now make Alcázar improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Alcázars provide +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture per adjacent Encampment. Provides [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 50% of the tile's Appeal. Occupying unit receives +1 Sight and +4 [ICON_STRENGTH] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 1 turn of fortification. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be built next to another Alcázar.

zh.name: 马斯喀特宗主国加成
zh.description: 拥有商业中心的城市+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。

zh.name: 米特拉宗主国加成
zh.description: 拥有学院区域的城市增长率将提升15%。

en.name: Mitla Suzerain Bonus
en.description: City growth rate is 15% higher in cities with a Campus district.

zh.name: 纺织会馆
zh.description: 波兰特色建筑。从此城开始的国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力；国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+4 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

en.name: Sukiennice
en.description: A building unique to Poland. International [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes from this city gain +2 [ICON_Production] Production; domestic [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes gain +4 [ICON_Gold] Gold.

zh.name: 翼骑兵
zh.description: 文艺复兴时期波兰特色单位。如果输出的伤害点数高于敌方，则会将防守的敌方单位弹至后方的单元格中。如防守单位无法后退，则将受到更高的伤害。

en.name: Winged Hussar
en.description: Polish unique Renaissance era unit. Pushes defending enemy units back from their hex in any battle where they score more damage. Defenders that cannot retreat suffer additional damage.

zh.name: 立陶宛联邦
zh.description: 创立和完成 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教时分别获得一个 [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] 遗物。[NEWLINE][ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] 遗物提供+4 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和+2 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]圣地从相邻的其他区域处获得标准相邻加成，而非少量相邻加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]因您的文化炸弹而失去单元格的城市，您的 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教将成为为其主流宗教。

en.name: Lithuanian Union
en.description: Holy Sites gain standard Faith adjacency from adjacent [ICON_DISTRICT] Districts.[NEWLINE]All [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics generate an additional +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +4 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Receive a [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relic when founding and when completing a Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Religion founded by Poland becomes the majority in an adjacent city that loses a tile to a Polish Culture Bomb.

zh.name: 贵族民主制
zh.description: 解锁"帝国初期"市政后，将1个军事政策槽位转换为通配符槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]军营和堡垒建成时会触发文化炸弹。

en.name: Golden Liberty
en.description: At Early Empire, One Military policy slot in the current [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government is converted to a Wildcard policy slot.[NEWLINE]Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing an Encampment or Fort inside friendly territory.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 塔赛提
zh.description: 陆地与海军远程单位+30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力和+50%战斗经验值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建立在战略资源上的矿山提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。建立在加成和奢侈品资源上的矿山提供+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T2平原 / T5矿山资源。

en.name: Ta-Seti
en.description: +30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Ranged and Naval Ranged units. All Ranged and Naval Ranged units gain +50% combat experience. Mines over strategic resources provide +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION]. Mines over bonus and luxury resources provide +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T2 Plains, T5 Minable Resources.

zh.name: 麦罗埃的甘达刻
zh.description: 建造 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域时+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力（如果该城市建有努比亚金字塔，则提升至+40%）。

en.name: Kandake of Meroë
en.description: +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts, increasing to +40% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if there is a Nubian Pyramid in the city.

zh.name: 希腊文化融合
zh.description: 占领一座城市时，提供以下加成：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 您所有城市的 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力+20%，持续10个 [ICON_TURN] 回合。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 该城市中每有一个军营或学院，触发一项 [ICON_TECHBOOSTED] 尤里卡。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 该城市中每有一个剧院广场或圣地，触发一项 [ICON_CIVICBOOSTED] 鼓舞。

en.name: Hellenistic Fusion
en.description: Receive boosts upon city conquest: +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in all cities for 10 [ICON_TURN] turns, as well as a [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka for each Encampment or Campus in the conquered city and an [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration for each Holy Site or Theater Square.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 皇家学堂
zh.description: 马其顿特色建筑，替代兵营。建造近战单位、抗骑兵单位、陆地远程单位或特色单位时+25% [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗经验值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在这个城市中生产一个非平民单位时，将获得等于其成本25%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

en.name: Basilikoi Paides
en.description: A building unique to Macedon. +25% combat experience for all melee, ranged land units, and Hetairoi trained in this city. Gain [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 20% of the unit's [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost when a non-civilian unit is trained in this city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Stable.

zh.name: 马其顿特色单位：持盾护卫
直到世界尽头
zh.description: 城市不会产生厌战情绪。[NEWLINE]如果您占领了一座拥有世界奇观的城市，您所有的军事单位将完全恢复生命值。[NEWLINE]击杀敌方单位时，获得等同于其基础 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力20%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值（联机速度下）。

en.name: To World's End
en.description: Combat victories provide [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 20% of the [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength of the defeated unit (on Online speed). Cities do not incur war weariness. All military units heal completely when this player captures a city with a world wonder. Gain the Hetairoi unique unit after unlocking Horseback Riding.

zh.name: 荣耀而短促的一生
zh.description: 喜欢与马其顿之外其他国家交战的文明；鄙视处于和平的文明。

en.name: Short Life of Glory
en.description: Likes civilizations at war with major powers other than Macedon. Has disdain for civilizations at peace.

zh.name: 行省总督
zh.description: 您的国内 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币（“银行业”科技后提升至+4，“经济学”科技后提升至+6）。[NEWLINE]解锁“政治哲学”市政后，+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]领土内的道路提升一个等级。

en.name: Satrapies
en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity with Political Philosophy. Receive +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for domestic Trade Routes, and an additional +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold with Banking and Economics. Roads built in your territory are one level more advanced than usual.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 波斯庭院
zh.description: 波斯特色改良设施，解锁于“帝国初期”市政。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。[NEWLINE]每相邻1个市中心、工业区、港口或商业中心，提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]每相邻1个市中心、学院、剧院广场或圣地，提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]“外交部门”市政后额外提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]为相邻单元格提供+1魅力。[NEWLINE]“飞行”科技后基于文化产出提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不能建在雪地和冻土单元格上。两座波斯庭院不能相邻。

en.name: Pairidaeza
en.description: Persian unique builder improvement unlocked with Early Empire. Cannot be built on Snow tiles, Tundra tiles or Floodplains. Cannot be build next to another Pairidaeza.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold, +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with Diplomatic Service.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent City Center, Holy Site, Campus, and Theater Square.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each adjacent City Center, Commercial Hub, Harbor, and Industrial Zone.[NEWLINE]+1 Appeal to adjacent tiles.[NEWLINE]Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight.

zh.name: 长生军
zh.description: 波斯古典时代特色近战单位，替代剑客。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有远程攻击能力（[ICON_RANGE] 射程为1）。

zh.name: 巴比伦的陨落
zh.description: 您的国内 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（“中世纪集市”市政后提升至+3，“城市化”市政后提升至+5）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]所有波斯军事单位进攻时+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有驻军的被占领城市每回合+5忠诚度。[NEWLINE]宣布突袭战争在计算 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满和好战度时等同于正式战争。

en.name: Fall of Babylon
en.description: All units get +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking. +5 Loyalty per turn in occupied cities with a garrisoned unit. Declaring a Surprise War counts as a Formal War for the purposes of [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances and warmongering.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for domestic Trade Routes, and an additional +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with Medieval Faires and Urbanization.

zh.name: 机会主义者
zh.description: 喜欢宣布突袭战争的领袖。讨厌不宣布突袭战争的领袖。

en.name: Opportunist
en.description: Likes leaders who have declared a Surprise War. Dismisses leaders who do not use Surprise War declarations.

zh.name: 南方大陆
zh.description: 商业中心、学院、剧院广场和圣地建在魅力为“迷人的”单元格上时获得+1相邻加成（“惊艳的”单元格为+3）。[NEWLINE]解锁“帝国初期”市政后，市中心建在魅力为“迷人的”单元格上时+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度（“惊艳的”单元格为+2）。[NEWLINE]所有海岸城市+3 [ICON_Housing] 住房。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]牧场可触发文化炸弹，并在解锁“政治哲学”市政后额外提供+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T1海岸、T4牧场资源、-T2泛滥平原、-T4雨林。特殊：可能在无淡水海岸生成。

en.name: Land Down Under
en.description: +3 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing in coastal cities. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production on Pastures at Political Philosophy. Pastures trigger a Culture Bomb.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unlocked at Early Empire, City Centers gain +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity if they are Charming, doubled if Breathtaking.[NEWLINE]Campuses, Theater Squares, Commercial Hubs, and Holy Sites receive +1 Adjacency in tiles with Charming Appeal, +3 in Breathtaking.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias:T1 Coast, T4 Horse, Cattle, Sheep, -T2 Floodplains, -T4 Rainforest. Special "I am Salty", may spawn coastal without freshwater.

zh.name: 文明的大本营
zh.description: 解放城市后，所有城市10 [ICON_TURN] 回合内+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

en.name: Citadel of Civilization
en.description: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for 10 [ICON_TURN] turns after liberating a city.

zh.name: 林地克里人
zh.description: 解锁“制陶术”科技后，+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]克里的 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 商人首次进入克里城市3单元格内的无主单元格时，该单元格将划入克里领土。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T4鹿、牛、马、羊。

en.name: Nîhithaw
en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity with the Pottery technology.[NEWLINE]Unclaimed tiles within 3 tiles of a Cree city come under Cree control when a Trader first moves into them.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Deer, Cattle, Horses, Sheep.

zh.name: 大河地带
zh.description: 学院、剧院广场和工业区如果相邻河流，获得+2相邻加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造堤坝和拦洪坝建筑时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建成港口后触发文化炸弹。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T2河流、T3海岸。

en.name: Grote Rivieren
en.description: Major adjacency bonus for Campuses, Theater Squares, and Industrial Zones if next to a river.[NEWLINE]Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Harbor.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_Production] Production toward the Dam district and Flood Barrier building.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T2 Rivers, T3 Coast.

zh.name: 驿站
zh.description: 建立 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线后，立刻在目的地城市创建一个 [ICON_TRADINGPOST] 贸易站。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]由 [ICON_VISLIMITED] 外交能见度提供的 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力加成翻倍。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T4马。

en.name: Örtöö
en.description: All Mongolian units double the usual [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Bonus for having a higher level of [ICON_VisLimited] Diplomatic Visibility than their opponent. Starting a [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route immediately creates a [ICON_TRADINGPOST] Trading Post in the destination city.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Horses.

zh.name: 苏格兰启蒙运动
zh.description: 幸福度为“快乐”的城市：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] +5% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 工业区提供+1 [ICON_GREATENGINEER] 大工程师点数。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 学院提供+1 [ICON_GREATSCIENTIST] 大科学家点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]对于“欣喜若狂”的城市，这些加成翻倍；对于“极度兴奋”的城市，这些加成乘三。

en.name: Scottish Enlightenment
en.description: Happy cities receive an additional +5% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Happy cities generate +1 [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist point per Campus and +1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer point per Industrial Zone. Ecstatic cities double all these amounts. Euphoric (+8 amenity) cities triple these amounts.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 三国鼎立
zh.description: 书院为相邻单元格提供额外产出：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 相邻农场提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 相邻矿山提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T4平原丘陵与草原丘陵。

en.name: Three Kingdoms
en.description: Mines receive +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for every adjacent Seowon district. Farms receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every adjacent Seowon district.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Grassland and Plains Hills

zh.name: 团结就是力量
zh.description: 建造城墙建筑时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代开始时选择着力点，不仅能获得时代专属加成，还能同时获得该着力点在 [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] 普通时代下提升时代得分的加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T4采石场资源。

en.name: Strength in Unity
en.description: When making Dedications at the beginning of a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age, receive the [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age bonus towards improving Era Score in addition to the other bonus.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards walls.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Quarry Resources.

zh.name: 托奇
zh.description: 对于拥有 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督的城市：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力（如果不是您建立的城市，提升至+15%）。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] +5% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（如果不是您建立的城市，提升至+15%）。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 训练的单位获得+10%战斗经验值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 为9单元格范围内的城市提供+4忠诚度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T4山脉（平原和草原） / -T3泛滥平原。

en.name: Toqui
en.description: Cities with an Established [ICON_Governor] Governor provide +5% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +5% [ICON_Production] Production, and +10% experience in combat towards all units trained in this city. These numbers are tripled in cities not founded by the Mapuche. All cities within 9 tiles of a city with your  [ICON_Governor] Governor gain +4 Loyalty per turn towards your civilization.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Grassland and Plains Mountain, -T3 Floodplains.

zh.name: 部落礼赞
zh.description: 解锁相应市政后，使用常规单位占领城市将使其升级为 [ICON_CORPS] 军团或舰队，使用军团或舰队占领城市将使其升级为 [ICON_ARMY] 军队或无敌舰队。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有驻军的城市+3忠诚度（如果是军团或军队则+5）。

en.name: Isibongo
en.description: Cities with a garrisoned unit get +3 Loyalty per turn, or +5 if it is a [ICON_CORPS] Corps or [ICON_ARMY] Army. Conquering a city with a unit will upgrade it into a [ICON_CORPS] Corps/Fleet or [ICON_ARMY] Army/Armada if that unit was already a Corp/Fleet, if the proper Civics are unlocked.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 伊布托
zh.description: 解锁“雇佣兵”市政即可组建 [ICON_CORPS] 军团，解锁“民族主义”即可组建 [ICON_ARMY] 军队。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“动员”市政后，[ICON_CORPS] 军团和 [ICON_ARMY] 军队额外获得+2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。

en.name: Amabutho
en.description: May form [ICON_CORPS] Corps at the Mercenaries Civic and [ICON_ARMY] Armies at the Nationalism Civic. Corps and Armies both gain +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] base Combat Strength at the Mobilization Civic.

zh.name: 政事论
zh.description: 拥有神社的城市训练的军事单位+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。[NEWLINE]拥有寺庙的城市训练的军事单位+1视野。[NEWLINE]城市圣地中每拥有一座建筑，该城市训练的军事单位+1 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。

en.name: Arthashastra
en.description: Shrines grant +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and Temples grant +1 Sight for all newly trained military units in the city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Units receive +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for each Holy Site building in the city when produced.

zh.name: 班诺克本
zh.description: 所有侦察单位获得+50%经验值。

en.name: Bannockburn
en.description: Recon units receive +50% combat experience.

zh.name: 花郎
zh.description: 拥有 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督的城市+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE]城市中就职的 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督每拥有一级晋升，书院建筑的产出便提升30%。[NEWLINE]解锁“封建主义”市政后，没有 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督的城市产出-10%。解锁“封建主义”市政时获得1个 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督头衔。

en.name: Hwarang
en.description: +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity for cities with a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor.[NEWLINE]+30% yield to Seowon buildings for each [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor promotion in the city.[NEWLINE]When you unlock Feudalism, cities you founded without a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor receive -10% to all yields. +1 [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor Title at Feudalism.

zh.name: 世界、王国和信仰的荣光
zh.description: 如果您的 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教是帝国的主流宗教，您向信奉该宗教的城邦派遣 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者时，视为派遣了2名。[NEWLINE]每个城邦 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]击杀单位时，获得等同于其基础 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力50%的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值（联机速度下）。

en.name: Glory of the World, Kingdom and Faith
en.description: Killing a unit provides [ICON_FAITH] Faith equal to 50% of the defeated unit's base [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength (on Online speed). Each [ICON_ENVOY] Envoy you send to a City-state of your majority Religion counts as two [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys (must have a majority Religion). Earn +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith per Envoy in a City-state.

zh.name: 有利条件
zh.description: 您发出的 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线可从目的地城市3单元格内的每个营地或牧场获得+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。接收的国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线可为您的城市从目的地城市3单元格内的每个营地或牧场提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]所有类型的同盟都会提供共享视野。

en.name: Favorable Terms
en.description: All Alliance types provide Shared Visibility.[NEWLINE]Your outgoing [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes grant +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food to Poundmaker per Camp or Pasture at the destination. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes sent to your cities grant +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold to Poundmaker per Camp or Pasture at the destination.

zh.name: 橙色电台
zh.description: 您的国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]外国通往您城市的国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线为其起点城市提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值，为您的目的地城市提供+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]您的国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线为起点城市提供+2忠诚度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]海军单位位于圩田单元格上时+3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]学院提供+1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] 海军统帅点数。

en.name: Radio Oranje
en.description: Your [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to your own cities provide +2 Loyalty per turn for the origin city. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to foreign cities or from foreign cities provide +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture to you and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for the sender. +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for all naval units when defending on a Polder improvement. Dutch campuses provide +1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] Great Admiral point.

zh.name: 迅捷之鹰
zh.description: 与自由城市或处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代的文明作战时，+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]在敌方城市领土内击杀敌方单位，会使该城市损失15点忠诚度（如果该文明处于黄金或英雄时代则损失30点）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有军营的城市的单元格+1魅力。

en.name: Swift Hawk
en.description: +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when fighting Free Cities or civilizations that are in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age. Defeating an enemy unit within the borders of an enemy city causes that city to lose 15 Loyalty, doubled if that civilization is in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tiles in cities with an Encampment receive +1 Appeal.

zh.name: 蒙古部落
zh.description: 所有骑兵单位（重骑兵除外）获得+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]击杀敌方骑兵单位时有几率将其俘获。

en.name: Mongol Horde
en.description: Light cavalry units and Keshig gain +3 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and a chance to capture defeated enemy cavalry class units.

zh.name: 威尼斯宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线根据目的地城市拥有的每种奢侈品资源，提供+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

en.name: Venice Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your international [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes earn +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Luxury resource at the destination.

zh.name: 安善宗主国加成
zh.description: [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] 著作提供+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] 遗物和 [ICON_GREATWORK_ARTIFACT] 文物提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

zh.name: 迦太基宗主国加成
zh.description: 城市中建成的每个军营区域建筑可使陆地战斗单位的购买 [ICON_GOLD] 金币-20%。

en.name: Carthage Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Land combat units are 20% cheaper to purchase with [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Encampment district building in that city.

zh.name: 耶路撒冷宗主国加成
zh.description: 您拥有圣地的城市散发的宗教压力等同于圣城（对12单元格范围内的所有城市施加4倍宗教压力）。拥有圣地的城市提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

en.name: Jerusalem Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your cities with Holy Sites exert pressure as if they were Holy Cities (4x Religion pressure on all cities within 12 tiles). +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Holy Site.

zh.name: 普雷斯拉夫宗主国加成

zh.description: 您拥有建筑的区域使相应类型的 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数+1（拥有建筑的剧院广场区域提供 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、[ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家和 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数）。

en.name: Stockholm Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your districts with a building provide +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point of their type ([ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, and [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician for Theater Square districts with a building).

zh.name: 维尔纽斯宗主国加成

en.name: Vilnius Suzerain Bonus
en.description: All your Theater Square districts receive +50%/+100%/+150% adjacency bonus if you have at least one active Alliance of Level 1/2/3.

zh.name: 世界工厂

en.name: Workshop of the World

Military Engineers receive +2 [ICON_CHARGES] charges. Buildings that provide additional yields when [ICON_POWER] Powered receive +3 of that yield. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast, T5 Iron and Coal.

zh.name: 阿卡德宗主国加成

zh.name: 博洛尼亚宗主国加成
zh.description: 拥有建筑的 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供1点对应的 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人点数（剧院广场提供大作家、大艺术家和大音乐家点数）。

zh.name: 卡霍基亚宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“卡霍基亚土墩”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。提供+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度（每座城市仅限1个土墩提供，解锁“自然历史”市政后提升至2个）。解锁“封建主义”市政后，每相邻2个 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物（“零件规格化”科技后提升至每相邻1个区域）。+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房（“文化遗产”市政后提升至+2）。两座卡霍基亚土墩不能相邻。

zh.name: 加的夫宗主国加成

en.name: Cardiff Suzerain Bonus
en.description: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold, and +2 [ICON_POWER] Power for every Harbor building.

zh.name: 非斯宗主国加成

zh.name: 墨西哥城宗主国加成

en.name: Mexico City Suzerain Bonus

zh.name: 纳斯卡宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“纳斯卡巨画”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]为相邻单元格提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。为拥有资源的相邻单元格额外提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。“行政部门”市政后，为相邻沙漠及沙漠丘陵额外提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。“批量生产”科技后，为相邻平坦单元格额外提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。为相邻单元格提供+1魅力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]只能建在平坦的沙漠上。所在单元格无法被市民工作。

zh.name: 纳札加姆宗主国加成

en.name: Ngazargamu Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Land combat or Support units are 10% cheaper to purchase with [ICON_GOLD] Gold or [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each Encampment district building in that city.

zh.name: 拉帕努伊宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“摩艾石像”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。每相邻2座摩艾石像提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（“中世纪集市”市政后提升至每相邻1座）。建在火山土或与火山土相邻的单元格时提供+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。与海岸或湖泊相邻时提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。“飞行”科技后基于文化产出提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。可建在平原、草原和火山土（含丘陵）上。

en.name: Rapa Nui Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Builders can now make Moai improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every 2 adjacent Moai, increasing to each adjacent Moai at Medieval Faires. +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if on or adjacent to a Volcanic Soil tile. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Can be built on Plains, Plains Hills, Grassland, Grassland Hills, or Volcanic Soil.

zh.name: 和平四颜
zh.description: 无法宣布突袭战争，也无法对城邦宣战，其他文明也无法对您宣布突袭战争。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每累积100点 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩，每回合提供+1 [ICON_FAVOR] 外交支持。[NEWLINE]成功完成紧急状况或积分竞赛时，获得的 [ICON_FAVOR] 外交支持翻倍（+100%）。

en.name: Four Faces of Peace
en.description: Cannot declare war on City-states or surprise wars. Surprise wars cannot be declared on Canada.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For every 100 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per turn earn 1 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor per turn. Receive +100% [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor from successfully completing an Emergency or Scored Competition.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Tundra.

zh.name: 多瑙河之珠
zh.description: 在市中心河对岸修建 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域与建筑时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T4河流、T5地热裂缝。

en.name: Pearl of the Danube

en.name: Mit’a
en.description: Citizens can work Mountain tiles. Mountain tiles provide +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, increasing to +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production after you reach the Industrial Era, and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Terrace Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cities do not suffer penalties on non-food yields for being negative amenities.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Grassland and Plains Mountains. Special "Mountain Lover".

zh.name: 杰利之歌
zh.description: 沙漠单元格：[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet] 解锁“对外贸易”市政后，市中心在沙漠上提供+2 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值（无论位于何种地形，[ICON_CAPITAL] 首都都会获得+2 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值）。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet] 提供+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet] 矿山提供+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet] 允许建造农场。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]可以使用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值购买曼丁哥市场的建筑。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T1沙漠 / T5矿山资源（铀除外）。

en.name: Songs of the Jeli
en.description: +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food on all featureless Desert tiles other than City Centers.[NEWLINE]After Foreign Trade, your capital and any cities settled on Desert tiles gain +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE]Farms can be constructed in Desert. After Civil Engineering is unlocked, Farms can be built on Desert Hills.[NEWLINE]Mines on desert tiles grant +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Can purchase Suguba buildings with [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Desert, T5 Minable Resources.

zh.name: 玛那
zh.description: 解锁“天文导航”科技后，渔船提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]未改良的树林和雨林单元格在解锁“帝国初期”市政后提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力（“重商主义”市政后提升至+2，“保护地球”市政后提升至+4）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“造船术”科技后，水运单位获得+2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]无法收获资源，无法获得 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T1海岸。

en.name: Mana
en.description: Embarked units gain +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement with Ship Building. Fishing Boats provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food with Celestial Navigation. Resources cannot be harvested. [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writers cannot be earned.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unimproved Woods and Rainforest tiles gain:[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Early Empire.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Mercantilism.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Conservation.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 帕堡
zh.description: 一种特色改良设施

zh.name: 达达尼尔射石炮

en.name: Great Turkish Bombard
en.description: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward siege units. All siege units gain +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.[NEWLINE]Conquered cities do not lose [ICON_CITIZEN] population. Cities not founded by the Ottomans gain +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity and +4 Loyalty per turn.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rivers, T5 Niter.

zh.name: 地中海殖民地

en.name: Mediterranean Colonies
en.description: Begin the game with the Writing technology [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka. Coastal cities founded by Phoenicia and located on the same continent as the Phoenician [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital are 100% Loyal.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 诺贝尔奖
