en.name: Nobel Prize
en.description: Sweden gains 20 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor (on Standard speed) when earning a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person. Having Sweden in the game adds three unique World Congress competitions starting in the Renaissance Era.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Campus, Industrial Zone and Government Plaza buildings.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer point from Industrial Zone buildings.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist point from Campus buildings.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATWRITER] Great Writer points from tier 1 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATARTIST] Great Artist points from tier 2 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] Great Musician points from tier 3 Gov't Plaza building. +2 [ICON_GREATSCIENTIST] Great Scientist points and +2 [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer points per tier of Government Plaza building.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: Special "King of the North"

zh.name: 迦太基建国者
zh.description: 市政广场中每拥有一座建筑，便提供+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE]拥有市政广场的城市建造 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]登船的开拓者+2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力和+2视野。[NEWLINE]开拓者上下船不消耗额外的 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。

en.name: Founder of Carthage
en.description: Settlers gain +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and +2 sight range while embarked. Settlers ignore additional [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement costs from embarking and disembarking.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity for each Government Plaza building. +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward [ICON_DISTRICT] districts in the city with the Government Plaza.

zh.name: 爱之法庭
zh.description: 建造剧院广场区域的建筑时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]巨作根据其类型和所在城市拥有的区域提供额外产出：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 巨作类型：[ICON_GreatWork_Writing] 著作和 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物提供+1对应产出；[ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 艺术巨作和 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物提供+2对应产出；[ICON_GreatWork_Music] 音乐巨作提供+4对应产出。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 区域类型：拥有社区提供 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；拥有工业区提供 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；拥有港口或商业中心提供 [ICON_GOLD] 金币；拥有学院提供 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值；拥有剧院广场提供 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值；拥有圣地提供 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]埃莉诺无法利用安善的城邦宗主加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在9单元格范围内，埃莉诺的城市中每拥有一件巨作，外国城市每回合的忠诚度便-1。如果一座城市因埃莉诺的忠诚度压力叛变为自由城市，它将直接加入埃莉诺的文明。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]仅埃莉诺（法国）：建造远古和古典时代的世界奇观时+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.name: Court of Love
en.description: +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Theater Square Buildings.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Works receive additional yields based on the districts built in this city (+1 for [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Writings and [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] Relics, +2 for [ICON_GREATWORK_LANDSCAPE] Art and [ICON_GREATWORK_ARTIFACT] Artifacts, +4 for [ICON_GREATWORK_MUSIC] Music):[NEWLINE][ICON_SCIENCE] Science for Campus.[NEWLINE][ICON_CULTURE] Culture for Theater Square.[NEWLINE][ICON_GOLD] Gold for Harbor or Commercial Hub.	[NEWLINE][ICON_FAITH] Faith for Holy Site.[NEWLINE][ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for Industrial Zone.[NEWLINE][ICON_FOOD] Food for Neighborhood.[NEWLINE](Can't receive bonus yields on great works from Anshan)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Works in Eleanor's cities each cause -1 Loyalty per turn in foreign cities within 9 tiles. A city that leaves another civilization due to a loss of Loyalty and is currently receiving the most Loyalty per turn from Eleanor's civilization skips the Free City step to join this civilization.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When Eleanor leads France receive +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward ancient and classical wonders.

zh.name: 北方的弥涅耳瓦
zh.description: 拥有至少3个巨作槽位的建筑以及拥有至少2个巨作槽位的奇观，在填满时自动获得 [ICON_THEMEBONUS_ACTIVE] 主题化加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]可以在市政广场建造女王图书馆。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]市政广场建筑根据等级提供以下点数：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+2 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家点数（一级）[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+2 [ICON_GREATARTIST] 大艺术家点数（二级）[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+2 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] 大音乐家点数（三级）[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+2 [ICON_GREATSCIENTIST] 大科学家点数和+2 [ICON_GREATENGINEER] 大工程师点数（每一级）

zh.name: 库佩的航行
zh.description: [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都提供+3 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]开拓者在解锁“航海术”科技后即可下水。

en.name: Kupe's Voyage
en.description: Settlers can embark after researching the Sailing technology. The Palace grants +3 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.

zh.name: 西部净土
zh.description: 位于冻土的市中心获得+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。允许在冻土上建造农场。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在冻土和雪地单元格上：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 营地和农场+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 牧场+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 矿山和伐木场+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 战略资源积累速度翻倍。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 购买这些地形的单元格花费降低50%。

en.name: The Last Best West
en.description: City Centers in Tundra receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Farms can be constructed in Tundra. After Civil Engineering is unlocked, Farms can be built on Tundra Hills. Improvements in Tundra and Snow receive the following bonuses: Mines and Lumber Mills +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, Farms and Camps +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, Pastures +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food. Receive double the normal accumulation rate for Strategic Resources improved in tundra and snow. -50% of the normal cost to purchase Snow and Tundra tiles.

zh.name: 渡鸦之王
zh.description: 城邦征集单位+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。升级征集单位花费的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币和资源减少75%。[NEWLINE]如果您征集了某城邦的军队，您将在该城邦获得1名 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者。

en.name: Raven King
en.description: Levied units gain an ability giving them +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. It cost 75% less [ICON_GOLD] Gold and resources to upgrade Levied units. If you Levy troops from a City-state, receive 1 [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys with that City-state. Gain the Black Army unique unit when the Castles technology is researched.

zh.name: 萨赫勒商人
zh.description: 解锁“银行业”科技后，+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造圣地及其建筑时+10% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]曼丁哥市场可从圣地获得大量相邻加成。

en.name: Sahel Merchants
en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity after Banking. Holy Sites grant major adjacency to Sugubas. +10% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Holy Sites and their buildings.

zh.name: 印加路网
zh.description: 起源城市中的每座山脉单元格，为您国内的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物，为国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“对外贸易”市政后即可获得印加路网。

en.name: Qhapaq Ñan
en.description: Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes gain +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every Mountain tile in the origin city. International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes gain +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every Mountain tile in the origin city. -50% of the normal [ICON_GOLD] Gold cost to purchase Mountain tiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain the Qhapaq Ñan improvement with Foreign Trade. Recon units gain +1 [ICON_CHARGES] build charge to build a Qhapaq Ñan.

zh.name: 大维齐尔
zh.description: 您可以使用一位拥有独特军事和外交技能的专属 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督（易卜拉欣）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“火药”科技时获得+1 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督头衔。

zh.name: 古迹与公园
zh.description: 解锁“法典”市政后，魅力值为“惊艳的”单元格获得以下加成：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 与自然奇观或山脉相邻时，+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值（“天文学”科技后提升至+2）。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 与自然奇观或树林相邻时，+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（“启蒙运动”市政后提升至+2）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“中世纪集市”市政后即可栽种树林。

en.name: Antiquities and Parks
en.description: After Code of Laws, breathtaking tiles receive:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science when adjacent to either a Natural Wonder or a Mountain, doubled with Astronomy.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when adjacent to either a World Wonder or Woods, doubled with Enlightenment.[NEWLINE]Woods can be planted with Medieval Faires.

zh.name: 德瑞克的遗产
zh.description: 解锁“造船术”科技、“探索”市政和“重商主义”市政时，各获得+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE]您通往城邦的 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线为起点城市中每个特色 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]海军单位掠夺 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线获得的收益+100%。[NEWLINE]海军袭击者单位+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力和+1视野。海军袭击者单位进行 [ICON_PROMOTION] 升级时不结束当前回合。

en.name: Drake's Legacy
en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity with Shipbuilding technology, Exploration civic and Mercantilism civic. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to City-states provide +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every [ICON_DISTRICT] specialty district in the origin city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All Naval Raider units gain +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and +1 Sight. Naval Raiders can attack and promote in the same turn. +100% [ICON_GOLD] Gold from Plundering [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes with Naval Units.[NEWLINE]Receive the unique unit the Sea Dog which replaces the privateer.

zh.name: 北欧卫队
zh.description: 建造圣地建筑时+25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]木板教堂每回合提供+1 [ICON_INFLUENCEPERTURN] 影响力点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]您每宗主一个城邦，海军单位进攻时+1 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]征集单位获得提升：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 征集花费减少75%。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 击杀单位时获得等同于其基础 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力50%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、[ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值（联机速度下）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当您使用宗教单位首次转换一座城市时，该城市每有1个 [ICON_CITIZEN] 公民，您便获得10点 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和10点 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.name: Varangian Guard
en.description: +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength on naval units when attacking per City-state you are suzerain of. 75% Discount on Levying units and levied units receive [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith from kills equal to 50% of the opponent's [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength. +1 Movement to levied units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+25% production to Holy Site buildings. Stave Church generates +1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] Influence point. +10 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +10 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture (standard speed) per population when converting a city to your religion for the first time using a religious unit.

zh.name: 蒸汽时代
zh.description: 建造工业区建筑时+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]城市中每有一座工厂和发电厂提供+5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]工业区从皇家海军船坞获得标准相邻加成。[NEWLINE]所有已改良战略资源+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]灯塔提供+1 [ICON_GREATENGINEER] 大工程师点数。

en.name: Age of Steam
en.description: +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in Cities for each Factory and Power Plant in that city.Industrial Zones receive standard adjacency from Royal Navy Dockyards. +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Industrial Zone buildings.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to all improved Strategic Resources.[NEWLINE]Lighthouse grants +1 [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer point per turn.

zh.name: 解放黑奴宣言
zh.description: 建造工业区和水渠时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]工业区提供+2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度和每回合+3 忠诚度。[NEWLINE]工业区建筑提供+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]完成工业区或其建筑后免费获得1个近战单位。免费单位的生成与维护不需要消耗战略资源。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]种植园每回合-2 忠诚度。

en.name: Emancipation Proclamation
en.description: +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Industrial Zone and Aqueduct districts. Industrial Zones give +2 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities and +3 Loyalty per turn. Buildings in Industrial Zones gives +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Plantations give -2 Loyalty per turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive a free Melee unit after completing an Industrial Zone and their buildings. The free unit does not require strategic resources when created or to maintain.

zh.name: 王者之师
zh.description: 位于使徒周围2单元格内的军事单位+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]可以使用正常 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值消耗的90%来购买军营和学院区域的建筑。

en.name: The Victorious
en.description: Military units receive +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength if they are within 2 tiles of an apostle.  Can purchase encampment and campus buildings with faith at a 10% discount.[NEWLINE]All Units cost 1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold less maintenance per turn.

zh.name: 恩东戈和马坦巴的女王
zh.description: 拥有姆班赞的城市+15% [ICON_GOLD] 金币和+15% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（不可叠加）。商业中心和剧院广场相邻姆班赞时获得+2相邻加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]购买考古学家的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币花费减少50%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]平民单位在树林和雨林单元格中移动时没有 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力惩罚。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_GREATMERCHANT] 大商人点数。

en.name: Queen of Ndongo and Matamba
en.description: +15% [ICON_GOLD] Gold and 15% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture in cities with a Mbanza (does not stack with multiples). Mbanza provides +2 adjacency to Theater Squares and Commercial Hubs. Archaeologists are 50% cheaper to purchase.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All civilian units ignore the Rainforest and Woods [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement penalty.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive 50% more [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant points.

zh.name: 三十六计
zh.description: 建造军营建筑时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。军营提供+1 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家点数。兵营和马厩拥有2个 [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] 著作槽位。[NEWLINE][ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] 著作提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]招募 [ICON_GREATGENERAL] 大将军或 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家时获得一项随机的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]近战单位可将相邻的蛮族转化为己方单位，但会消耗该近战单位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]长城如果与另外两个长城单元格相邻，额外提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.name: Thirty-Six Stratagems
en.description: Melee units receive the Convert Barbarians action, which consumes the melee unit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Encampment buildings. +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer point from Encampment districts. Barracks and Stable buildings provide 2 slots for [ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] Great Works of Writing. Great Works of Writing provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When recruiting a Great General or Great Writer receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration.

zh.name: 里甲
zh.description: 所有城市都可以开展3种特殊项目“里甲”，分别能将城市当回合 70% 的 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力转化为 [ICON_FOOD] 食物或 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值，或将 150% 转化为 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]10个人口或以上的城市，每1个人口便提供+0.5 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+0.7 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和+0.5 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每当有城市首次达到13 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口时，获得一项随机的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。每当有城市首次达到18 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口时，获得一项随机的 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]长城如果与另外两个长城单元格相邻，额外提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。

en.name: Lijia
en.description: Cities with 10 or more [ICON_CITIZEN] Population receive +0.7 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +0.5 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +0.5 [ICON_GOLD] Gold per turn for each [ICON_CITIZEN] Population in the city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All cities receive unique city projects where that converts 70% of their [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production into [ICON_FOOD] Food or [ICON_FAITH] Faith, or 150% if it is [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When each city reaches 13 [ICON_CITIZEN] population for the first time receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka; at 18 [ICON_CITIZEN] Population receive a random [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration.

zh.name: 罗织经
zh.description: 进攻性间谍的行动效果提升1级。当进攻性间谍任务成功时，您将获得目标城市该回合产出的100% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、[ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在解锁“行政部门”市政时免费获得1名间谍，且间谍容量+1。可以使用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值购买间谍。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]侦察单位周围3单元格内的陆地军事单位+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建成市政广场或外交区建筑时，获得一项随机的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]长城如果与另外两个长城单元格相邻，额外提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

en.name: Manual of Entrapment
en.description: Receive a free spy (and extra spy capacity) after discovering Civil Service. Can purchase Spies with [ICON_FAITH] Faith. All offensive Spies operate at 1 level higher. Whenever an offensive spy mission is successful, you also gain 100% of the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith that the targeted city earned that turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Land units within 3 tiles of a Recon unit receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When completing a Government Plaza building or Diplomatic Quarter building receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration.

zh.name: 阿布辛贝
zh.description: 若城市建立在河流旁，建造工业区和圣地时+15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]相邻河流的圣地获得+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建成建筑时，获得等同于其 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力花费10%的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（若该城市拥有世界奇观，则提升至20%）。[NEWLINE]建成世界奇观时，获得等同于其 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力花费25%的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.name: Abu Simbel
en.description: Gain [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 10% of the construction cost when finishing Buildings, doubled for cities with a wonder and 25% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when completing Wonders. Holy Sites are granted +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if built adjacent to a River.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+15% production bonus for Holy Sites and Industrial Zones when the city is settled on a river.

zh.name: 哈庇的降临
zh.description: 若城市建立在河流旁，建造军营和学院时+15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]军营和学院从相邻河流获得+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值相邻加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]从古典时代开始，河流不再对军事单位造成 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力和 [ICON_Movement] 移动力减益。

en.name: Arrival of Hapi
en.description: Military units can cross rivers without movement or combat penalty starting in the classical era.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+15% production bonus for Campuses and Encampments when the city is settled on a river. Campus and Encampments receive major [ICON_SCIENCE] Science adjacency from rivers.

zh.name: 索格伦
zh.description: 招募 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币花费降低30%。[NEWLINE]同时拥有曼丁哥市场和剧院广场的城市每回合提供+1 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]市场拥有2个 [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] 著作槽位（仅限由松迪亚塔建立的城市）。[NEWLINE][ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] 著作提供+4 [ICON_GOLD] 金币和+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]曼丁哥市场可从剧院广场获得大量相邻加成。

en.name: Sogolon
en.description: Patronage of [ICON_GREATPERSON] Great People costs 30% less [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Theater Squares grant major adjacency to Sugubas. Cities with a Theater Square and Suguba receive +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer point. Markets gain 2 slots for [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Great Works of Writing in cities founded by Sundiata. [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Great Works of Writing grant +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +4 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.

zh.name: 爱国军
zh.description: 解锁“政治哲学”市政后，军事单位+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。[NEWLINE]空中单位、骑兵或间谍升级时不结束当前回合。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T5种植园资源。

en.name: Ejército Patriota
en.description: +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for all military units after researching Political Philosophy. Promoting Cavalry units, Air units and Spies does not end these units' turn.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T5 Plantation Resources.

zh.name: 玛雅布
zh.description: 城市无法从淡水和海岸获得额外 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。[ICON_CAPITAL] 首都+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。市中心每相邻1个奢侈品资源获得+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]农场每相邻1个天文台，提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房和+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]种植园每相邻1个天文台，提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值（解锁“教育”科技后提升至+2）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3种植园奢侈品 / T4香蕉。

en.name: Mayab
en.description: Settling adjacent to Fresh Water and Coast does not provide extra [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. The Palace receives +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity for every Luxury adjacent to the City Center.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Farms provides an additional +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing, +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for every adjacent Observatory, and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Plantations provide +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for each adjacent Observatory and an additional +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science with Education.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Plantation Luxuries, T4 Bananas. Special "Hydrophobic".

zh.name: 荣耀之战
zh.description: 游戏每进入一个新时代，您就会获得一名总指挥。[NEWLINE]无法招募常规的 [ICON_GREATGENERAL] 大将军。

en.name: Campaña Admirable
en.description: Earn a Comandante General when the game enters a new era. May not recruit [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great Generals.

zh.name: 穆塔尔忠烈之女
zh.description: 在距离您的 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都6单元格范围内的城市，所有产出提升5%。其他城市（除首都外）所有产出降低10%。[NEWLINE]位于您 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都6格范围内的军事单位+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。

en.name: Ix Mutal Ajaw
en.description: Non-capital cities within 6 tiles of the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital gain +5% to all yields. Other non-capital cities receive -10% to all yields.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for units within 6 tiles of your [ICON_CAPITAL] capital.

zh.name: 卡瓜纳宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“巴特依”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。每相邻1个战略资源提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。每相邻1个奢侈品资源提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。每相邻1个加成资源和娱乐中心提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（“探索”市政后提升至+2）。“飞行”科技后基于文化产出提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。不能建在另一座巴特依旁。

en.name: Caguana Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Builders can now make Batey improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every adjacent Bonus Resource and Entertainment Complex, increasing to +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when Exploration is discovered. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for every adjacent Strategic resource. +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every adjacent Luxury resource. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be build adjacent to another Batey.

zh.name: 罕萨宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线每跨越5格距离，提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

zh.name: 拉合尔宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许使用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值购买拉合尔专属特色单位“尼杭战士”。它拥有专属晋升树。当您拥有兵营、兵工厂或军事学院时，各为尼杭战士提供+12 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。享受任何时代 [ICON_GREATGENERAL] 大将军的加成。

en.name: Lahore Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your cities can now train Nihang units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A unit with a unique Promotion tree. Purchasable with [ICON_FAITH] Faith. +15 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when Barracks, Armory, and Military Academy buildings are first constructed. Receives bonuses from [ICON_GREATGENERAL] Great General from any era.

zh.name: 新加坡宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.name: Singapore Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your international [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes provide +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.

zh.name: 塔鲁加宗主国加成
zh.description: 城市中每拥有一种已改良的战略资源类型，便提供+5% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

zh.name: 梵蒂冈城宗主国加成
zh.description: 激活 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人时，向6单元格范围内的所有城市施加400点您创立（或主流）的 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教压力。

en.name: Vatican City Suzerain Bonus
en.description: When you activate a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person they spread 400 Religious pressure of your founded (or majority) religion to cities within 6 tiles.

zh.name: 我来，我见，我征服
zh.description: 近战、远程、攻城和重骑兵单位获得+50%经验值（中世纪后提升至+100%）。这些单位每拥有一级 [ICON_PROMOTION] 晋升，+1 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建立城市时，获得您当前解锁的最强近战单位。解锁“法典”市政时，[ICON_CAPITAL] 首都获得一个勇士。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果您征服了一座由其他玩家建立的城市（且您至少控制一座），将获得1个额外的通配符槽位。

en.name: Veni, Vidi, Vici
en.description: Melee, Siege, Ranged and Heavy Cavalry units receive +50% Combat Experience, increasing to +100% when entering the medieval era. These units receive +1 Combat Strength per promotion received.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive a free melee unit each time you found a non-capital city and in your capital after researching Code of Laws.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain an extra Wildcard Policy slot when capturing and retaining at least one city founded by a major civilization and owned by a major civilization at the time of capture (maximum 1 extra wildcard slot).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain the Onager unique unit when Engineering is researched.

zh.name: 天授规矩
zh.description: 每有1座圣城皈依拜占庭的 [ICON_Religion] 宗教（包括拜占庭自己的圣城），单位获得+2 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力或+3  [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]击杀敌方文明或城邦的单位时，将会向附近的城市传播您的 [ICON_Religion] 宗教。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]圣地提供+1 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数。

en.name: Taxis
en.description: Units receive +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength or [ICON_RELIGION] Religious Strength for each Holy City converted to Byzantium's Religion (including Byzantium's Holy City). +1 [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet point from cities with a Holy Site district.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When defeating a unit, spreads Byzantium's Religion pressure (based on melee [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength of the defeated unit) within 5 tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 哈尔施塔特文化
zh.description: 所有 [ICON_DISTRICT] 特色区域：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 从相邻的采石场获得+1标准相邻加成。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 从相邻的矿山获得+0.5少量相邻加成。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 无法从其他区域获得常规相邻加成。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 不能与市中心相邻。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3铁、T5可建造采石场与矿山的加成/奢侈品资源。

en.name: Hallstatt Culture
en.description: Quarries grant a standard adjacency bonus for all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts (doubled for the Oppidum) and Mines grant a minor adjacency bonus for all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts. Specialty [ICON_DISTRICT] districts do not receive a minor adjacency for being adjacent to another district and these districts cannot be built adjacent to the City Center.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Iron, T4 Quarry Resources, T5 Minable Resources.

zh.name: 厄勃隆尼斯之王
zh.description: 您的近战和抗骑兵单位每相邻一个军事单位，+1 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“铸铜术”科技后，完成陆地军事单位的训练将获得等同于其25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力花费的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造矿山会触发文化炸弹。

en.name: King of the Eburones
en.description: Mines trigger a culture bomb when built, claiming surrounding unowned tiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Melee and anti-cavalry units receive +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for each adjacent military unit. Receive [ICON_CULTURE] culture equal to 25% of the production cost of all military units you train after unlocking Bronze Working.

zh.name: 生于紫室
zh.description: 对所信仰 [ICON_Religion] 宗教与您主流宗教相同的城市发起进攻时，轻重骑兵将造成全额伤害。

zh.name: 九龙江三角洲
zh.description: 所有的陆地特色 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域只能建在雨林、沼泽或树林单元格上。[NEWLINE]建在这些地貌上的建筑会获得额外产出：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 建在沼泽上：+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 建在雨林上：+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 建在树林上：+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“中世纪集市”市政后即可栽种树林。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3沼泽、雨林和树林。

en.name: Nine Dragon River Delta
en.description: All land specialty districts can only be built on Rainforest, Woods, Marsh, or Floodplains. Receive the following yields for every building on these features: +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science in Rainforest, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture in Woods, and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in Marsh, and no additional yields on Floodplains.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Woods can be planted with Medieval Faires.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rainforest, Woods, Marsh.

zh.name: 腰牌
zh.description: 任何 [ICON_GOVERNMENT] 政体都提供一个额外的经济政策槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（每跨越25格距离，再额外+1/+1）。[NEWLINE]首次在他国城市建立 [ICON_TRADINGPOST] 贸易站时，触发一项随机的 [ICON_TECHBOOSTED] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CIVICBOOSTED] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]仅中国：长城若与另外两个长城单元格相邻，额外提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.name: Gerege
en.description: One extra Economic policy slot in any [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture per international trade route and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each 25 tiles traveled on all trade routes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration when establishing a [ICON_TRADINGPOST] Trading Post in another Civilization's city for the first time.

zh.name: 驱除吴军
zh.description: 在您领土内的雨林、沼泽或树林单元格开始回合的单位，+2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。[NEWLINE]在雨林、沼泽或树林单元格上作战时，+2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力（如果在您的领土内则提升至+4）。

en.name: Drive Out The Aggressors
en.description: +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for all units beginning their turn in Rainforest, Woods, or Marsh tiles within your empire. +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when combat takes place on a forest, rainforest, or marsh tile. +4 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength on these tiles within your own empire.

zh.name: 寻欢作乐的凯瑟琳
zh.description: 已改良的资源单元格提供额外产出：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 解锁“技艺”市政后，+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 如果相邻剧院广场，再+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 如果相邻法国城堡（仅限奢侈品资源），+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]对于处于不同满意状态的城市（幸福度判定）：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 快乐：+5% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值；剧院广场+1 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家点数。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 欣喜若狂：+10% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值；剧院广场+1 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家和 [ICON_GREATARTIST] 大艺术家点数。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 极度兴奋：+15% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值；剧院广场+1 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家、[ICON_GREATARTIST] 大艺术家和 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] 大音乐家点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有剧院广场的城市可启动特色项目（宫廷盛会）。

en.name: Catherine’s Magnificences
en.description: Improved resources provide additional bonus yields:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture at Craftsmanship[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if adjacent to a Theater Square.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity if adjacent to a Chateau(luxury resources only)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Happy cities gain +5% Culture, doubled if the city is ecstatic, tripled if the city is euphoric (+8 amenity). Cities with a Theater Square gain these great people based on happiness level: +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer point if happy, +1 [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist point if ecstatic, and +1 [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician point if euphoric.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May initiate the Court Festival unique project in cities with a Theater Square.

zh.name: 幕藩
zh.description: 国内 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线根据目的地城市每个特色 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域，提供+0.5 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值（“教育”科技后提升至+1）和+0.5 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（“人文主义”市政后提升至+1）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]您发出或接收的国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线产出-25%，且无法对外国文明产生通常的25% [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]位于 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都6单元格范围内的城市为100%忠诚。“飞行”科技后，每个 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+1 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。

en.name: Bakuhan
en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes receive -25% Yields and [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism, but Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes provide +0.5 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture increasing to +1 with Humanism, and +0.5 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science increasing to +1 with Education for every Specialty District at the Destination. Cities within 6 tiles of Japan's capital receive 100% Loyalty and after researching Flight receive +1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism for every District.

zh.name: 波斯之剑
zh.description: 您的国内 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值（“教育”科技后提升至+3，“科学理论”科技后提升至+5）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]攻击生命值全满的单位和具有防御力的区域时+5 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。

en.name: Sword of Persia
en.description: +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking Defensible Districts and full health Units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for domestic Trade Routes, and an additional +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science with Education and Scientific Theory.

zh.name: 大帝
zh.description: 处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代时，+10% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]处于 [ICON_GLORY_DARK_AGE] 黑暗时代或 [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] 普通时代时，+2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力（对抗同样处于黑暗或普通时代的文明时，提升至+4 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力）。

en.name: The Magnificent
en.description: +10% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when not in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age, doubled against Civilizations who are also not in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age.

zh.name: 阿克苏姆的遗产
zh.description: 您的国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线根据起点城市的每种资源提供+0.5 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]解锁“政治哲学”市政后，已改良的资源提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]可以使用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值购买考古博物馆和考古学家。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3平原丘陵与草原丘陵。

en.name: Aksumite Legacy
en.description: Ethiopia's International Trade Routes grant +0.5 [ICON_FAITH] Faith per resource at the origin. Improved Resources provide +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith after unlocking Political Philosophy. Can purchase Archaeological Museums and Archaeologists with [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Grassland and Plains Hills.

zh.name: 内阁会议
zh.description: 建立在丘陵或资源上的城市，获得等同于其产出 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值10%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.name: Council of Ministers
en.description: Receive [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 10% of your [ICON_FAITH] Faith generation in cities founded on Hills or Resources.

zh.name: 巴比伦诸神
zh.description: 完成每座图书馆后获得一项免费的 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3河流。

en.name: Enuma Anu Enlil
en.description: Receive a free [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka after constructing each Library.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rivers.

zh.name: 尼鲁-伊路-辛鲁
zh.description: 首次建造每种 [ICON_DISTRICT] 特色区域（市政广场除外）时，获得当前可在该区域中建造的、所需 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力最低的建筑。

en.name: Ninu Ilu Sirum
en.description: When each [ICON_DISTRICT] specialty district type except the Government Plaza is constructed for the first time, receive the lowest [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost building that can currently be constructed in that district.

zh.name: 阿瑜陀耶宗主国加成
zh.description: 建成建筑时，获得等同于其 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力花费15%的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.name: Ayutthaya Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Gain [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 15% of the [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost when finishing buildings.

zh.name: 欣盖提宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+4 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。

en.name: Chinguetti Suzerain Bonus
en.description: International and Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes receive +4 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.

zh.name: 约翰内斯堡宗主国加成
zh.description: 城市每拥有一种已改良的资源类型（加成/奢侈品/战略资源），便提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。“弹道学”科技后额外+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。“工业化”科技后额外+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.name: Johannesburg Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Cities receive +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for each improved type of resource (bonus, luxury, strategic). Receive an additional +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production at Ballistics and at Industrialization.

zh.name: 那烂陀宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“大寺”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。每相邻1个学院提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值（“科学理论”科技后提升至+2）。每相邻1个圣地提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。建成首座大寺时，随机解锁1项免费科技。必须建在平坦地形上。两座大寺不能相邻。

zh.name: 撒马尔罕宗主国加成
zh.description: 允许建造者建造改良设施“圆顶市集”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。每相邻1个奢侈品资源提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。起源城市每拥有1座圆顶市集，从该城出发的国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线提供+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币和+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。两座圆顶市集不能相邻。

en.name: Samarkand Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Builders can now make Trading Dome improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each adjacent Luxury resource. Your outgoing international Trade Routes grant +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith per Trading Dome at the origin. Cannot be built next to another Trading Dome.

zh.name: 沃林宗主国加成
zh.description: 每次战斗胜利获得大将军（陆战）或海军统帅（海战）点数，数值等同于被击杀单位基础 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力的25%（标准速度下）。

zh.name: 童话国王
zh.description: 未完成和已完成的世界奇观每相邻一个 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域，提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。解锁“城堡”科技后，这些 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值产生等量 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]商业同业工会可从商业中心获得大量相邻加成。

en.name: Swan King
en.description: Wonders (complete and incomplete) receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every adjacent [ICON_DISTRICT] District as adjacency bonus. All [ICON_CULTURE] Culture adjacencies provide [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism with Castles. [NEWLINE]Hansa receives major adjacency bonus from Commercial Hubs.

zh.name: 悔改
zh.description: 跑马场和圣地每相邻一个农场提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“政治哲学”市政后，圣地每相邻一个 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.name: Metanoia
en.description: After researching Political Philosophy, Holy Sites provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent district. Farms provide a +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith adjacency to Hippodromes and Holy Sites.

zh.name: 谚文
zh.description: 当您研究完成新时代的第一项科技时，获得相当于当回合所产出 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值两倍的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]书院：每相邻一个剧院广场获得+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值，每相邻一个其他 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域-1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE]剧院广场：每相邻一个书院获得+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]同时拥有书院和剧院广场的城市，每个特色 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和+2 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“封建主义”市政后，训练建造者+30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.name: Hangul
en.description: When you complete your first Technology from a new Era, receive double your [ICON_SCIENCE] Science per turn as [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Seowons receive -1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for each adjacent District. Seowons and Theater Squares receive major adjacency from each other. Cities with a Seowon and a Theater Square receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +2 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per district. +30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward builders after Feudalism.

zh.name: 特蕾西亚改革
zh.description: 已就职的 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督提供以下加成：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]每回合+1 [ICON_INFLUENCEPERTURN] 影响力点数[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]建造区域时+15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]生产单位时+15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]若 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都中已建成对应区域，则所有该类型 [ICON_DISTRICT] 特色区域（首都除外）提供+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。

en.name: Theresian Reforms
en.description: Established [ICON_Governor] Governors provides : [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] Influence point per turn[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+15% [ICON_Production] Production towards districts[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+15% [ICON_Production] Production towards units[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Specialty districts provide +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing when a District of that type already exists in the [ICON_Capital] Capital.

zh.name: 边防军
zh.description: 奥地利特色侦察单位

en.name: Grenzer
en.description: A unique land unit

zh.name: 政治联姻
zh.description: 每次建成市政广场建筑时，获得一位专属的外交官伟人，能够吞并已宗主的城邦，且与其他文明的 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都相邻时，每回合+1 [ICON_FAVOR] 外交支持。。

en.name: Diplomatic Marriage
en.description: Receive an unique Diplomat Great Person when you build your government plaza buildings. A Diplomat can absorbs a city-state you're suzerain of and generates +1 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor per turn if adjacent to another player Palace.

zh.name: 咖啡馆
zh.description: 奥地利特色建筑。

en.name: Coffee House
en.description: A unique building

zh.name: 哥特与罗马
zh.description: 古冢6格范围内的非骑兵类陆地军事单位+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。

en.name: Gothorum Romanorumque
en.description: +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for non cavalry land military units in a 6 tiles radius from a Hlaiw.

zh.name: 战团兵
zh.description: 哥特特色近战单位。

en.name: Militōnd
en.description: A unique land unit

zh.name: 誓卫战士
zh.description: 哥特特色抗骑兵单位。

en.name: Gadrauht
en.description: A unique land unit

zh.name: 哥特人迁徙
zh.description: 解锁"帝国初期"市政后，首次建立或征服一座城市时，所有位于6格范围内且至少拥有2个空余 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房的城市，获得+1 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口。

en.name: Gothic Migration
en.description: At Early Empire, when settling or conquering a city for the first time receive +1 [ICON_Citizen] Population in every Gothic city within 6 tiles with at least 2 free [ICON_Housing] Housing.

zh.name: 古冢
zh.description: 哥特特色建筑。

en.name: Hlaiw
en.description: A unique building

zh.name: 印度之家
zh.description: [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线收益增加：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] “制图学”科技后，+50% [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] “教育”科技后，+50% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] “中世纪集市”市政后，+50% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线只能从沿海城市出发，且只能通往建立在海岸上或拥有港口的城市。[NEWLINE][ICON_TRADEROUTE] 商人单位的水域移动范围+50%，且一旦可用便能立即下水。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T1海岸。

en.name: Casa da Índia
en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes must originate from a coastal city and can only travel over water or canal tiles, but receive +50% [ICON_GOLD] Gold with Cartography, +50% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science with Education, and +50% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with Medieval Faires. Trader units have +50% range over water, and can embark as soon as they are unlocked.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 关闸
zh.description: 所有单位+1视野。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每次进入新时代（包含远古时代）时，+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]与所有城邦开放边界。

en.name: Porta do Cerco
en.description: All units receive +1 Sight. +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity when entering a new era (ancient era included). Open Borders with all City-states.

zh.name: 国家教育委员会
zh.description: 位于军营及其建筑旁的战略资源和改良单元格获得额外产出：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]军营：+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]兵营/马厩：+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]兵工厂：+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]军事学院：+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力

en.name: Commission for National Education
en.description: Strategic Resources and improved tiles gains bonus yields next to Encampment and its buildings (do not stacks) : [NEWLINE]- District : +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food [NEWLINE]- Barracks and Stable : +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture[NEWLINE]- Armory : +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science[NEWLINE]- Military Academy : +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain the Uhlan unique unit when they research the Metal Casting technology.

zh.name: 众卡比洛斯之秘仪
zh.description: 在拥有圣地和建有皇家学堂的军营的城市中，每个 [ICON_CITIZEN] 公民提供+0.5 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE]在同一城市中建成圣地和皇家学堂时，获得1名 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]您每宗主一个城邦，近战和重骑兵单位在进攻时便获得+2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。

en.name: Cabeiri Mysteries
en.description: Cities with a Basilikoi and Holy Site give 0.5 [ICON_SCIENCE] science per [ICON_CITIZEN] population.  +1 [ICON_ENVOY] envoy when a city first has both a Basilikoi and Holy Site. +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking for melee and heavy cavalry units per City-state you are Suzerain of.

zh.name: 海洋建筑
zh.description: 沿海和湖泊城市建造区域时+25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“航海术”科技后，未改良的礁石单元格提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T1海岸。

en.name: Coral Construction
en.description: Coastal cities gain +25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward districts.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for unimproved reef tiles with Sailing.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 千廊之殿
zh.description: 港口每相邻一座世界奇观，便提供+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。

en.name: Palace of Husuni Kubwa
en.description: [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity +1 for each Harbor adjacent to a World Wonder.

zh.name: 恩赐之父
zh.description: 厌恶那些争夺伟人但不发展自己城市的文明。钦佩在多数城市中拥有最多区域数量并容纳了许多伟人的文明。

en.name: Father of Gifts
en.description: Dislikes civilizations who are competing for Great People if they do not develop their cities. Admires civilizations that maintain the maximum number of districts in most cities and is home to many Great People.

zh.name: 世界屋脊
zh.description: 可以在山脉单元格上工作。山脉单元格根据2单元格内的区域获得额外产出：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 每有一个市中心提供+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 每有一个工业区提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 每有一个港口或商业中心提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 每有一个学院提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 每有一个剧院广场提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 每有一个圣地提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]可以使用 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值购买与山脉相邻的区域建筑（市政广场除外）。[NEWLINE]拥有 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督的城市，该总督每拥有一级晋升，城市 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值+5%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3山脉（平原、草原和冻土）。

en.name: Roof of the World
en.description: Citizens may work mountain tiles. Mountain tiles gain additional yields for each district within 2 tiles:[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food per City Center,[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production per Industrial Zone,[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold per Harbor and Commercial Hub,[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science per Campus,[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture per Theater Square,[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith +1 per Holy Site.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Can purchase buildings in specialty districts adjacent to a mountain tile with [ICON_FAITH] Faith, excluding the Government Plaza district.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+5% [ICON_FAITH] Faith in cities with a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor for each promotion it has.[NEWLINE]Bias: T3 Mountains (plain, grassland, and tundra).

zh.name: 长安之克
zh.description: 如果城市中拥有军营和祭祀建筑，该城训练的陆地军事单位初始便拥有一次 [ICON_PROMOTION] 免费升级。

en.name: Capture of Chang'an
en.description: Land military units trained in a city with an Encampment and a Worship Building start with a [ICON_PROMOTION] Promotion.

zh.name: 吐蕃天神圣裔，佛陀教法弘扬。
zh.description: 渴望进入黄金时代并追求较高的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值，同时尊重做法相同的文明。不喜欢处于黑暗时代或 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值较低的文明。

en.name: Great Enlightened, Miraculous, Divine Lord
en.description: Aims to achieve Golden Ages and high levels of [ICON_Faith] Faith, and respects those who do the same. Dislikes civilizations in a Dark Age, or who are low in [ICON_Faith] Faith

zh.name: 商贸王子
zh.description: 国际 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线根据起源城市的每种奢侈品资源，提供+0.5 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力和+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]解锁“写作”科技后可建造特色建筑“皇家陵墓”。

en.name: Merchant Princes
en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] trade routes provides +0.5 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Luxury resource in the origin city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unlock the Royal Tomb unique building.

zh.name: 保持谦卑
zh.description: 厌恶好战者，但喜欢与他建立贸易路线的文明。

en.name: Here and Be Humbled
en.description: Dislikes Warmongers, but likes those who send trade routes to him.

zh.name: 瓜蒂亚奥
zh.description: 提供 [ICON_GREATPERSON] 伟人点数的政策卡，为拥有对应 [ICON_DISTRICT] 特色区域的城市提供+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物，且该区域中的每个建筑额外提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_GOVERNMENT] 政体中每有一个外交政策槽位，拥有巴泰球场的城市+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。

en.name: Guatiao
en.description: Great Person Policies grant +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food per turn in cities that contain the district associated with that Great Person type, and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food in their corresponding buildings. Diplomatic Policies provide +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity in city with a Batéy.

zh.name: 极海鲸狩
zh.description: 与猎人小屋相邻的单元格获得额外产出（解锁“航海术”科技后生效，市中心除外）：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 冻土单元格+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 雪地单元格+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 营地和渔船+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物和+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造者可以消耗1次 [ICON_CHARGES] 劳动力和1个 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口在海岸单元格上创造 [ICON_RESOURCE_WHALES] 鲸鱼资源。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T2海岸 / T1冻土。

en.name: Hunting of the Bowhead
en.description: Builders can consume one [ICON_CHARGES] Charge and one [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen to create a [ICON_RESOURCE_WHALES] Whales tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]City Centers adjacent to a Hunter's House receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food. At sailing, tundra tiles adjacent to a Hunter's House receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food (doubled for snow). Adjacent Camps and Fishing boats receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. A tile may only benefit from a single Hunter's House.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bias: T1 Tundra, T2 Coast.

zh.name: 永远在漫游
zh.description: 喜欢派出探险者的文明。不喜欢不进行探索的文明。

en.name: Always Long to be Roaming
en.description: Likes civilizations who send out explorers. Dislikes civilizations that do not explore.

zh.name: 心非磐石
zh.description: 对于侦察单位：[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 在冻土或雪地上作战时+5 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE] [ICON_Bullet] 如果回合开始于冻土或雪地，+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力。

en.name: Heart Not Stone
en.description: +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength and +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for Recon units starting their turn on Tundra or Snow tiles.

zh.name: 达蒂奥
zh.description: 努力维持和平，并尊重同样珍视和平的文明。极度厌恶攻击城邦的文明。

en.name: Datiao
en.description: Tries to maintain peace and respects civilizations that do the same. Greatly dislikes civilizations that attack City-States.

zh.name: 金色之花
zh.description: 解锁"政治哲学"市政后，每个选择的时代着力点会提供一个不同类型的政策槽位：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]军事政策：鼓噪而进、全民皆兵和机器人大战[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]经济政策：自由探索、货币改革和漫天繁星[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]外交政策：百花齐放、此处有龙和兵不厌诈[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]通配政策：雄伟壮丽、滚滚蒸汽和愿你在此[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]快乐的城市+5% [ICON_GOLD] 金币（欣喜若狂的城市提升至+10%，极度兴奋的城市提升至+15%）。

en.name: Golden Flower
en.description: At [COLOR:212,115,212,255]Political Philosophy[ENDCOLOR], each chosen Era Dedication grants a different type of Policy slot:[NEWLINE]• [COLOR:217,67,67,255]Military[ENDCOLOR] policy:[NEWLINE]- Drums of War[NEWLINE]- To Arms![NEWLINE]- Automaton Warfare[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] • [COLOR:235,184,35,255]Economic[ENDCOLOR] policy:[NEWLINE]- Free Inquiry[NEWLINE]- Reform the Coinage[NEWLINE]- Sky and Stars[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] • [COLOR:103,204,4,255]Diplomatic[ENDCOLOR] policy:[NEWLINE]- Pen, Brush, and Voice[NEWLINE]- Hic Sunt Dracones[NEWLINE]- Bodyguard of Lies[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] • [COLOR:149,0,232,255]Wildcard[ENDCOLOR] policy:[NEWLINE]- Monumentality[NEWLINE]- Heartbeat of Steam[NEWLINE]- Wish You Were Here[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_GOLD] Gold +5% in Happy cities (increases to +10% in Ecstatic cities and +15% in Euphoric cities).

zh.name: 高卢邦联
zh.description: 解锁“铸铜术”科技后，矿山+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每个工作坊每回合提供+1 [ICON_INFLUENCEPERTURN] 影响力点数。

en.name: Gallic Confederation
en.description: +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture on mines with Bronze Working.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_INFLUENCEPERTURN] Influence per turn per Workshop and Recruiting a [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer grants 1 [ICON_ENVOY] envoy.

zh.name: 勇士之王
zh.description: 喜欢拥有强大军事力量的文明，但前提是他们没有被征服的城市。

en.name: King Over Warriors
en.description: Likes civilizations with strong armies, but only if they don’t own any captured cities.

zh.name: 金星之怒
zh.description: 从古典时代开始，位于 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都6单元格范围内的军事单位-2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]位于 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都7单元格或更远的军事单位+4 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当您获得一项 [ICON_TECHBOOSTED] 尤里卡时，所有军事单位恢复5点生命值并获得2点经验值。

en.name: Wrath of Venus
en.description: Once you enter the classical era, receive -2 [ICON_STRENGTH] combat strength for all units within six tiles of your [ICON_CAPITAL] capital. Units beyond 6 tiles receive +4 [ICON_STRENGTH] combat strength. Units heal 5hp and gain 2 experience points upon completing an [ICON_TechBoosted] eureka.

zh.name: 西境领主
zh.description: 波奇特卡聚集区及其建筑提供+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE]建造波奇特卡聚居区建筑时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]可招募独特 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督"浴火而生"。

en.name: Lord of the West
